name: Umeda Sky
source:
A man who has lived his whole life in Japan resolves to bring change into his life by going to Europe, for a vacation.

[From [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]Official Site.[/url]]

一名一生都在日本生活的男子决心改变人生，于是动身前往欧洲度假。
